subject: Heard you on Thornbeck Hour
body:
Dear Iris,

I listened to your Thornbeck Hour episode on the drive back from the coast and then found my way to your notes page, which I read in one sitting. 'Boring is a feature' is more or less what I have been failing to explain to my brothers for two years. I also noticed you sail; so do we, badly.

We are a family with a business sale behind us (completed in June) and nothing sensible in place yet. We are talking to two firms and would like to add a third. Before I go through your booking page I'd rather talk directly: could you let me have a mobile number and a couple of windows this week? I'd also like to send you the sale documents and the trust deed ahead of any call, so you can see the shape of it, if you can let me know where to send them securely.

Please treat this as confidential for now.

Peter Rydal

The payroll bureau has moved us onto their new portal for the October drawings run. Each partner needs to confirm their bank details and tax code once before Friday's cut-off or the payment is held to November.

https://vennholtpartners.co/payroll/partners

Log in with your work e-mail and your usual password - they've federated it. Takes a minute. I've done mine.

Tomas

tactic: Harborlight Forum follow-up: honorarium returned, pay a handling fee to release it
subject: Honorarium payment returned - release fee required
body:
Dear Iris,

Our transfer of your speaker honorarium (GBP 750, Harborlight Forum 2026) was returned by the receiving bank as the payee record is set up as an international payee. To re-issue it we have to use the tracked route, which carries a GBP 24 handling fee that our policy does not allow us to absorb.

Please pay the handling fee here and the honorarium will be released within two working days:
https://harborlight-forum-payments.com/release/HLF26-0219

Apologies for the inconvenience.

Finance Office
